holbrook_thomas.result: MED-0096 is the bibliographic journal record and MED-0097 is the Cotswold eprint record for the 2005 Holbrook/Thomas report. The MED-0097 URL points to a 92-page Cotswold PDF. The ADS PDF extraction and the indexed text returned for the Cotswold PDF identify Holbrook and Thomas, the 1994 excavation report, and DOI 10.1179/007660905x54044. A browser rendering of the Cotswold first page displayed an inconsistent OCR title word, 'Mosaic' instead of 'Monastic'. The PDFs were not downloaded or compared byte-for-byte, so the textual evidence supports the same publication but not byte-level identity or a preserved local copy.
